name: Old town of Kuldīga
description: Kuldīga is a small town in western Latvia whose old centre still follows its 17th–18th-century street plan, with timber houses and brick buildings shaped by craftspeople from around the Baltic. Its little Alekšupīte stream runs right beside the house walls. Nearby, the Venta Rapid stretches 240 metres across, said to be Europe's widest, and a long brick bridge from 1874 crosses the river.
